# The 15-cell responsive matrix

Phase 10 criteria 1-4, measured in the packaged application by `tools/baseline/responsive-matrix.mjs`. Five window
content sizes in device-independent pixels x three Windows display scales, four routes in every
cell. Every cell is listed: the criterion asks for all 15 checked and recorded, not sampled.

## The 15 cells

`Physical` is the DIP size times the scale; `CSS px` is what the renderer actually reported. They
disagree by a pixel or two at 125% and 150%, because Windows sizes the window in device pixels and a
fractional scale has no exact CSS-pixel equivalent for every size. The viewport is never SMALLER than
the cell asks for, which is the direction that would weaken the claim.

## Modals this harness cannot reach

| Dialog | Why |
|---|---|
| Restore prompt | needs a timer persisted by a previous launch; tools/smoke-packaged.mjs `timer` case owns that path |
| Attribution prompt | needs a pomodoro-created session with a NULL note, which only a completed work interval writes |

Both are measured by `Modal`'s own bounds, which every dialog shares, so what is unproven for them
is that their CONTENT fits - not that the panel does.
